name: The Jensen Farm
source:
Otto spots a familiar old truck in a parking lot and an offer to make the engine run smoother leads to a budding friendship with Finn.

Soon, Otto and Finn are hanging out together more and learning more about each other.

[From [url=https://thedrewedison.itch.io/the-jensen-farm]Itch.io[/url]]
